result.summary: 本文介绍了 Qwen2.5-VL 系列视觉语言模型，在视觉识别、目标定位、文档解析和长视频理解等方面取得进展 [abstract]。模型采用原生动态分辨率 ViT 与窗口注意力以降低计算开销，并引入动态 FPS 采样与绝对时间编码处理图像和长视频 [abstract][S1.p4]。实验表明，旗舰模型 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在文档与图表理解上可与 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 等模型匹敌，较小的 7B 与 3B 版本也优于同类竞品 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在推出 Qwen2.5-VL 系列模型，延续 Qwen 系列的开源理念，在多项基准上达到甚至超越顶级闭源模型 [S1.p4]。其动机是提升模型在视觉识别、精确目标定位、鲁棒文档解析和长视频理解等方面的基础能力与交互功能 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: In this report, we introduce the latest work Qwen2.5-VL, which continues the open-source philosophy of the Qwen series, achieving and even surpassing top-tier closed-source models on various benchmarks.

Qwen2.5-VL achieves a major leap forward in understanding and interacting with the world through enhanced visual recognition, precise object localization, robust document parsing, and long-video comprehension.

method.text: Qwen2.5-VL 由视觉编码器和语言模型解码器组成，视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算 [S2.SS1.p3]。模型引入动态 FPS 采样将动态分辨率扩展到时间维度，并升级 MRoPE 在时间域对齐绝对时间 [S1.p4]。在文档数据方面，作者将表格、图表、公式等元素统一格式化为 HTML，并整合布局框信息与坐标 [S2.SS2.SSS1.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: Structurally, we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
We introduce dynamic FPS sampling, extending dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension and enabling comprehensive video understanding across varied sampling rates
We upgrade MRoPE in the temporal domain by aligning to absolute time, thereby facilitating more sophisticated temporal sequence learning
These elements were uniformly formatted in HTML, which integrates layout box information and descriptions of illustrations into HTML tag structures.

experiments.text: 实验在多种数据集上评估 Qwen2.5-VL，并与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学任务、纯文本任务、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解以及 GUI Agent 等基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: The experimental section evaluates the performance of Qwen2.5-VL across a variety of datasets, comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
we selected several representative benchmarks to assess the model’s capabilities across a variety of domains, including general tasks, mathematics and science tasks, coding tasks, and alignment task.
in high-resolution real-world scenarios, specifically on the MME-RealWorld benchmark, Qwen2.5-VL demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with a score of 63.2
on composite OCR-related understanding benchmarks as OCRBench, InfoVQA which focusing on infographics, and SEED-Bench-2-Plus covering text-rich scenarios including charts, maps, and webs
Qwen2.5-VL achieves leading performance across different benchmarks from box-grounding, and point-grounding to counting.
The performance of Qwen2.5-VL-72B demonstrates exceptional advancements across GUI grounding benchmarks.

findings.text: 在大学水平问题上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上得分 70.2，在 MMMU-Pro 上得分 51.1，超越此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。在数学任务上，MathVista 得分 74.8，超过此前开源最优的 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。在空间理解上，ODinW-13 上达到 43.1 mAP，CountBench 上以“先检测后计数”提示达到 93.6 的准确率 [S3.SS3.SSS3.p3]。在 GUI 基准上，ScreenSpot 达到 87.1% 准确率，ScreenSpot Pro 达到 43.6%，远超 Aguvis-72B（23.6%）和 Qwen2-VL-72B（1.6%）[S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。较小的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 3B 也表现有竞争力，例如 MMStar 上分别为 63.9% 和 55.9% [S3.SS3.SSS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models and achieving performance comparable to GPT-4o.
On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
Qwen2.5-VL achieves a good performance of 43.1 mAP on ODinW-13
achieving a leading accuracy of 93.6 on CountBench with Qwen2.5-VL-72B using a “detect then count”-style prompt.
It achieves 87.1% accuracy on ScreenSpot, competing strongly with Gemini 2.0 (84.0%) and Claude (83.0%)
setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%)
on the MMStar dataset, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 63.9%, while Qwen2.5-VL-3B scores 55.9%.
